decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).
Condition : 2 - The details of the sections, elevations (scale 1:20) and materials of the proposed brise-soleils and flues to the front elevation of the 3 buildings shall not be otherwise than as shall have been submitted to and approved by the Council before any work is commenced on the relevant part of the development.  These parts of the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies EN1, EN13 and EN31 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.
Condition : 3 - The details of the sections, elevations (scale 1:20) and materials of the flue to the roof of Nos. 28 & 30 shall not be otherwise than as shall have been submitted to and approved by the Council before any work is commenced on the relevant part of the development. These parts of the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies EN1, EN13 and EN31 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.
Condition : 4 - The proposed glazed roof enclosure to the rear of No. 26 shall be obscure glazed in accordance with the glass sample submitted and shall be permanently retained and maintained as such.

Reason: In order to prevent unreasonable overlooking of neighbouring premises in accordance with the requirements of policies EN1 and EN19 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.
description: Revision to planning permission dated 29.03.04 ref: PWX0302267 for the erection of an additional storey to each of the dwellinghouses at Nos. 26-30 Ornan Road, involving enclosure of the rear balcony at No. 26 with obscured glazed panels, minor alterations to the rear balcony of Nos. 28 & 30, reduction in depth of the front balcony across all 3 houses, minor alterations to the glazing to the front elevation and the barrel roofs, addition of rooflights and brise-soleils to the front elevation of all 3 houses and metal flues to roofs of Nos. 28 & 30.
